verdict: needs-work
addresses-problem: yes — The design and AC row deliver a current-user-only CSV with id and name columns. The Tests section asserts owner isolation with two owners. Both requirements in the Human input are covered.
findings:
- [major] not-actionable @ "implements a current-user CSV download" — The spec never names the route, HTTP method or entry point for the download. It also leaves the response contract undefined: Content-Type, Content-Disposition/filename, whether a header row is emitted, and column order. An implementer and the handler test cannot agree on what to call or assert. → Name the route and method (e.g. `GET /widgets/export.csv`). State `Content-Type: text/csv`, a header row `id,name` in that order, and the filename. Add these to the AC row and the test. — probed: none
- [major] gap @ "Export contains only the current user's widgets" — The spec does not cover unauthenticated requests or a user with zero widgets. With no current user, the owner-scoped query's behavior is undefined, and that is an isolation risk. → Add: unauthenticated requests get 401 (or redirect, per existing convention). A user with no widgets gets a header-only CSV. Cover both in Tests. — probed: none
- [minor] ambiguity @ "using the existing owner-scoped widget query and CSV encoder" — Neither component is named, so an implementer must guess which query and encoder are meant. → Name the query method/scope and the encoder class or library. Note that the encoder escapes commas, quotes and newlines in `name`. — probed: none
- [minor] ambiguity @ "PR: acme/widget#12 - Export CSV" — This repo is acme/widgets, but the PR reference reads `acme/widget`, in both "PR under rework" and "Rework record". The provenance link would point at the wrong or a nonexistent repo. → Correct both references to `acme/widgets#12`. — probed: none
- [minor] external-ref @ "supersedes doc/specs/old-export.md, CSV export scope" — The spec references the old spec without stating what changes relative to it. A reader cannot tell whether any prior behavior is retained or dropped. → Add one line naming what the old export scope did and what this spec replaces. — probed: none
lean: nothing to cut
